description: Real registry responses for packages/package-guard, recorded by packages/package-guard/scripts/capture-fixtures.ts and replayed by its tests, which never use the network. Paths mirror the request: <host>/<decoded path>.json, with .head.json for a HEAD request, and api.osv.dev/v1/querybatch/<ecosystem>/<name>/<version or all>.json for one OSV query. Each file holds the status and the body: JSON keeps only the fields the guard reads (deps.dev version keys, publish times and the default flag; npm name, version, scripts and gypfile; PyPI release file types and upload times; Go proxy Version and Time; OSV ids), any other body is the text as returned.
